title: pack.yaml — mission-pack metadata contract (PRD FR-004)
description: Machine schema for pack.yaml. Human companion doc: docs/pack-yaml-schema.md (T005). SCHEMA validity is not RELEASE validity: evidence-bearing fields accept null so fixtures conform; the T006 validator fails nulls at release time. Airlock is the sole system of record — this file stores pointers and derived summaries, never findings. pack.yaml is never parsed by the bash installer (FR-004, C-002).

name.description: Pack name; matches the assets/packs/<name>/ directory (FR-001).

mission_guide.description: FR-007(a): scaffold-relative path of the human-facing mission guide. null is schema-valid (fixtures) and a T006 release failure.

component_notes.description: FR-007(b): per-component usage/key-setup notes. Either one scaffold-relative path, or a map of component id -> scaffold-relative path. null is schema-valid (fixtures) and a T006 release failure.

rules_file.description: FR-007(c): scaffold-relative path of the Codex-facing pack rules file. null is schema-valid (fixtures) and a T006 release failure.

pack_paths.description: Pack-authored assets (mission guide, notes, rules file, .codex/config.toml) as scaffold-relative paths. Must be disjoint from every component's vendored_paths; the union of all component vendored_paths plus pack_paths must equal the scaffold/ tree exactly. That partition is T006 validator-checked semantics, not schema-expressible.

components.description: Vendored third-party components. May be empty for a kit-authored pack whose whole scaffold is covered by pack.pack_paths.

nullableDigest.description: Evidence-bearing digest/pointer: null is schema-valid (fixtures; T006 release failure), otherwise a non-empty digest string in the same encoding airlock records for content_hash so values are directly comparable.

nullableRecord.description: Evidence-bearing provenance record: null is schema-valid (fixtures; T006 release failure), otherwise a non-empty string pointer or a structured object.

id.description: Stable component identifier, unique within the pack.

kind.description: Component kind. kind: mcp additionally requires dependency_audit, required_env, and setup_steps.

upstream_url.description: Canonical upstream URL of the component.

staging_fork.description: Staging-fork reference. Opaque identifier by default; a URL only when the fork is public and safe to distribute (NFR-002: no private-infra URLs).

pinned_commit.description: Exact commit pin (full 40-hex SHA-1, or 64-hex SHA-256). Required when scan_target is source-tree.

version.description: Exact published package version. Required when scan_target is npm-artifact.

scan_target.description: Brief decision 11 discriminator. source-tree requires pinned_commit; npm-artifact requires version and the two-layer provenance block.

vendored_paths.description: The component's vendored root(s) within scaffold/. Ownership partition: every vendored third-party byte belongs to exactly one component's set (T006 validator-checked).

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Redistribution policy is NOT decided here: the T006 validator checks this value against verification/pack-validator/license-allowlist.txt (T020); expressions and LicenseRef-* fail closed there.

airlock_evidence_id.description: Airlock evidence-bundle ID (airlock-authoritative pointer). null: fixture-only; T006 release failure.

engine_pin.description: Scanner engine pin at scan time (airlock-authoritative). null: fixture-only; T006 release failure.

scan_date.description: Scan date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), airlock-authoritative. null: fixture-only; T006 release failure.

verdict.description: Derived summary of airlock's tier/verdict fields per brief decision 2's disjoint mapping (documented verbatim in docs/pack-yaml-schema.md). Airlock stays authoritative; the manifest never invents a verdict airlock did not record. verdict: pass-with-accepted-risk requires the accepted_risk block.

content_hash.description: Airlock evidence content_hash (airlock-authoritative). null: fixture-only; T006 release failure.

vendored_tree_digest.description: Digest of the component's vendored-path set, computed with the FR-005 tree-hash recipe (same algorithm airlock uses for content_hash) so the two are directly comparable. null: fixture-only; T006 release failure.

provenance.description: npm-artifact two-layer provenance (FR-004): the SLSA attestation binds the published tarball; the scan binds the vendored tree. Required when scan_target is npm-artifact.

tarball_digest.description: Digest of the original published tarball.

attestation_record.description: SLSA provenance attestation record, verified at staging via `npm audit signatures` (brief decision 11).

transformation_record.description: Transformation record: the lockfile-generation command and its inputs.

scanned_tree_digest.description: Final scanned-tree digest (the airlock content_hash for this component).

dependency_audit.description: Transitive-dep audit summary + pointer (brief decision 6). Raw results live in the airlock evidence bundle; the pack carries only this derived summary and pointer. Required when kind is mcp.

summary.description: One-line derived summary of the audit outcome.

lockfile_digest.description: Digest of the exact lockfile audited.

report_digest.description: Digest of the raw audit report stored in the airlock evidence bundle.

report_location.description: Evidence-bundle-local location of the raw audit report (gate-host-local pointer; unresolvable target-side).

adjudication.description: Adjudication state. T006 fails release on anything other than accepted (FR-005).

accepted_risk.description: Required when verdict is pass-with-accepted-risk. Carries airlock's residual_risk_accepted_reason and deployment conditions VERBATIM (evidence pointers are gate-host-local and unresolvable target-side), each mapped to its enforcement point. Airlock stays authoritative; on conflict, airlock wins (T006 compares these verbatim against the evidence bundle in release mode).

reason.description: Verbatim residual_risk_accepted_reason from the airlock evidence bundle.

condition.description: Verbatim deployment condition from the airlock evidence bundle.

enforcement_ref.description: Pointer to the concrete enforcement location: mission-guide step, setup command, or rules-file section.

required_env.description: Env var names the component's server requires. Values are never stored; .codex/config.toml uses env_vars to inherit named variables without storing their values (FR-006). Required when kind is mcp.

setup_steps.description: Copy-pasteable, user-run setup commands (outside ./bootstrap). Required when kind is mcp. The .codex/config.toml/setup-flow contract itself is T012; this field records declarations only.
